features.name: rtt_last_ms
features.definition: RTT of the most recently ARRIVED echo (arrival - send, sender clock)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: rtt_mean_short_ms
features.definition: mean RTT of echoes that arrived in (t-short, t]
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: rtt_max_short_ms
features.definition: max RTT of echoes that arrived in (t-short, t]
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: rtt_std_short_ms
features.definition: sample std-dev of RTT in the short window (needs >= 2 echoes)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: rtt_mean_long_ms
features.definition: mean RTT of echoes that arrived in (t-long, t]
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: rtt_trend_ms
features.definition: rtt_mean_short - rtt_mean_long (positive = RTT rising)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: rtt_slope_ms_per_s
features.definition: least-squares slope of RTT over echo arrival time in the short window (needs >= 3 echoes)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: jitter_ms
features.definition: mean |RTT(seq+1) - RTT(seq)| over seq-consecutive echoes in the short window (RTT-delta jitter, as in traffic/metrics.py)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: loss_rate_short
features.definition: share of probes SENT in (t-short-grace, t-grace] whose echo had not arrived by t
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: loss_rate_long
features.definition: same over (t-long-grace, t-grace]
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: time_since_last_echo_ms
features.definition: t - arrival time of the newest echo
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: echo_overdue_ratio
features.definition: time_since_last_echo / probe interval, where the interval is the median spacing of the (up to 200) most recent probes sent <= t. In steady state it stays below 1 (it only reflects the phase of the probe clock); >= 1 means an echo is overdue
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: goodput_short_kbps
features.definition: echoed payload bits / observed span, short window (probe load is constant: this is delivered load, not capacity)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: goodput_long_kbps
features.definition: same over the long window
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: retransmit_count_long
features.definition: approach 'retransmit' events (mobility-signalling retransmissions) in (t-long, t]
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: timeout_failure_count_long
features.definition: approach 'failure' events (registration timeout/failure, connection failure) in (t-long, t]
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: handoffs_started_recent
features.definition: handoffs whose handoff_start is in (t-history_window, t]
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: handoffs_started_total
features.definition: handoffs started at or before t
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: time_since_last_handoff_start_s
features.definition: t - start of the latest handoff that started <= t (NaN if none yet)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: time_since_last_handoff_end_s
features.definition: t - end of the latest handoff that ENDED <= t (NaN if none yet)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: last_handoff_duration_ms
features.definition: end - start of the latest handoff that ended <= t (NaN if none yet)
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

features.name: handoff_in_progress
features.definition: 1 if a handoff started <= t has not ended by t
features.missing_value: NaN (imputed with the training median + indicator in the model pipeline)

unavailable_features.name: signal_strength_dbm
unavailable_features.reason: no radio model: the emulator has fixed link delays and an up/down state. Simulated network measurements are NOT physical radio signal strength.

unavailable_features.name: link_quality_indicator
unavailable_features.reason: the emulator exposes no link-layer quality indicator

unavailable_features.name: position_or_speed
unavailable_features.reason: the simulated mobile node has no position or velocity; movement is a scheduled interface switch

unavailable_features.name: queue_length_or_buffer_occupancy
unavailable_features.reason: simnet has no queues (documented in docs/MOBILITY_COMPARISON.md)

unavailable_features.name: available_bandwidth_estimate
unavailable_features.reason: probes are a constant low-rate load; they cannot estimate capacity

unavailable_features.name: tcp_retransmissions_for_tcp_approach
unavailable_features.reason: TcpLite keeps a retransmission counter but the adapter does not log it, so it is not observable from the run files

unavailable_features.name: owd_ms
unavailable_features.reason: one-way delay needs receiver-side timestamps in the same clock domain; available only in same-host runs and deliberately not used (the predictor runs at the sender)

unavailable_features.name: quic_path_validation_signal
unavailable_features.reason: aioquic is not installed here; the QUIC adapter was never run (PROJECT_STATUS K1)

notes: All measurements are SIMULATED network measurements from the Stage 4/5 emulator (virtual time, fixed link delays).
No feature is, or approximates, physical radio signal strength.
